subject: a thick saffron loop with a pale teal inner face
pose: twisted once into a compact half-knot
art_direction: 粗藏红环带扭成半结，青色内面与双层柔影让简约几何具备雕塑感。
visible_description: 金黄色粗环带扭成不规则圆环，青色内面与轻柔投影让简约几何具备雕塑感。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create a thick saffron loop with a pale teal inner face. Keep the loop continuous with a clear central opening and no loose ends. Its outer surface is matte, while the inner face catches a cooler reflected light. Two overlapping soft shadows reveal the twist without visual clutter. Place it on a plain ivory background and avoid metallic shine, labels, or extra shapes. Use matte abstract ribbon sculpture. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
